ab-bhī.def: , adv. Even now, yet, as yet, still.

ab-tab.def: , adv. Now and then, presently, very shortly:

ab-tab karna.def: , To put off continually, to delay; to evade, shuffle:

ab-tab hona.def: , To be in a dying state, to be at the point of death.

ab-tak.def: and ab-talak , adv. Up to the present time, till now; as yet, hitherto; all this time.

ab-se.def: , adv. From this time, henceforth, henceforward, in future, hence:

ab-se dūr.def: , Far be it from us! Heaven preserve us! Avaunt! (The phrase is generally used — especially by women — to deprecate the recurrence of a past misfortune).

ab-kā.def: , adj. (f. - kī ). Of the present; for the present; this, the present; the next, the following, the coming; new, fresh:

ab-ke.def: , adv. This time, the next time:

ab-lag.def: , ab-loṅ , ab-le , ab-leṅ , adv. = ab-tak , q.v.

ab-na-tab.def: , adv. Neither now nor then; neither here (on earth) nor in the world to come; nowhere; never.

ab-hī.def: , adv. Just now, this very moment, instantly, immediately; already.

āb-āb honā.def: , To be drenched with perspiration; to be thoroughly ashamed or abashed; to blush.

īb-utarnā.def: , To lose lustre or polish, become dull; to rade; to lose honour, be disgraced.

āb-bāzī.def: , s.f. Play or sport in water; swimming.

āb-pāshī.def: , s.f. Sprinkling water; watering fields, &c.; irrigation.

āb-tāb.def: (and āb o tāb ), s.f. Brightness, brilliance, lustre, splendour; dignity, grandeur, majesty, glory, pomp:

āb o tāb denā.def: (- ko ), To impart lustre (to); to glorify, praise, honour.

āb-tāba.def: , s.m. An ewer with a spout, a jug.

āb-i-jārī.def: , s.m. Running water, stream, rivulet; tears running down the cheeks.

āb-josh.def: , s.m. Juice of cooked meat, broth, soup, gravy.

ābā o ajdād.def: , s.m. Fathers; forefathers, ancestors; family, race; lineage, line.

ābād-bashī.def: , s.f. First assessment of newly settled or cultivated land.

ābād-rahnā.def: , To be full, stored, flourishing, prosperous, happy or comfortable.

ābād-kār.def: , s.m. The first settler on waste land.

ābād-karnā.def: , v.t. To make (a place) habitable; to people, settle, found (a colony, &c.); to build and plant; to cultivate; to make (the heart, dil ) rejoice, to comfort, r

ābād honā.def: , To be full, flourishing, &c. ( = ābād rahnā , q.v.); to be occupied (as a house); to have the prospect of issue; to be married.

ubāl ā-jānā.def: , v.n. To commence boiling, get into a state of ebullition:

ubāl denā.def: , v.t. To boil, cause to boil ( = ubālnā ).

ibtidā-se.def: , adv. From the beginning, ab initio: — ibtiaā karnā , v.t. To begin, commence, originate:

ibtidā-meṅ.def: , adv. In the beginning, at first, originally.

abtar karnā.def: , v.t. To ruin, spoil, mar, vitiate, deprave, corrupt; to derange, disarrange, disorder, to shuffle (a pack of cards).

ubṭan malnā.def: , To rub the body with ubṭan ( = ubaṭna ).

abjad-ḵẖẉān.def: , s.m. One who is learning the alphabet; a beginner (syn. nau-āmoz ).

abr ćhānā.def: , v.n. Clouds to overshadow; to be cloudy or overcast; to lower.

abr-i-ʻālamgīr.def: , s.m. Rain clouds which cover a large extent of country.

abr-i-qibla.def: , s.m. Clouds which come from the direction of the qibla ; clouds heavily charged with rain.

abr khulnā.def: , v.n. Clouds to disperse; (the sky) to be clear.

abrā ćaṛhānā.def: (- par ). To sow or quilt another, or outer, fold ( upon a garment).

ubrā-subrā.def: , s.m. Remainder; surplus; remains, fragments, remnants; leavings; scraps; refuse.

Abrū-par girī mārnī.def: , To knit the brow, to frown.

Abʻād-i-s̤alās̤a.def: , s.m. The three dimensions (of a solid body).

abikt-ganit.def: , s.f. The arithmetic of unknown quantities, algebra.

ubal ćalnā.def: , v.n. To flow or run over, boil over; to begin to swell or rise, &c.

ābla-i-farang.def: , s.m. The European pox, syphilis; bubo.

ablah-fareb.def: , s.m. A sly, wily knave; an impostor.

iblīs-kā peshāb.def: , and iblīs-kā janā , s.m. The devil's own child, the devil's brat.

ibnuʼl-amīr.def: , adj. Of noble blood, high born:

ibnuʼs-sabīl.def: , s.m. A son of the road, a traveller:

ibnuʼl-g̠aib.def: , s.m. A God knows who, an obscure person, an upstart, a parvenu:

abnā-i-jins.def: , s.m. Those of the same rank, quality, kind, or species; companions, comrades, equals. abnā-i-dahr , s.m. and abnā-i-rozgār , s.m. Sons of the time, contempora

ābnūs-kā kundā.def: , adj. ( Lit. 'a log of ebony'); black and ill-featured, repulsive: — s.m. A repulsive man; a blackamoor.

abuʼl-bashar.def: , Lit . 'The father of the human race'; Adam.

abuʼl-ḥāris̤.def: , s.m. The lion (he being among beasts of prey, the strongest to acquire ).

abū-bakr.def: , Lit . 'The father of the virgin'; the name of the father-in-law of, and first successor to, Mohammad.

abū-turāb.def: , Lit . 'Father dusty;' a nickname of 'Alī, the son-in-law of Mohammad.

abū-jahl.def: , Lit . 'Father of ignorance,' the name of an uncle of Mohammad, noted for his stubbornness.

abū-ʻalī-sīnā.def: , The name of a celebrated sage and physician.

abū-huraira.def: , Lit . 'Father (owner) of the little cat'; the nickname of one of Mohammad's disciples (who was in the habit of carrying a pet cat about with him).

ubhārā denā.def: , v.t. To carry off, bear away; to incite, persuade, encourage, entice:

ubhārā karnā.def: , v.t. To unload, &c. (see ubhārnā and ubhrānā ).

ubhār-lānā.def: , v.t. To unload and bring; — to incite, induce, work upon, persuade, win over, seduce, draw over; to procure, obtain.

ubhār-le-jānā.def: , v.t. To carry off, bear away, &c. (see above).

abhāl-ānā.def: and abhāl ćhānā , v.n. To be clouded or overcast.

abhiruć rakhnā.def: (- meṅ ). To have or take delight (in).

ubhar ānā.def: = ubharnā in most of its significations.

ubhar ćalnā.def: , To be on the rise or increase; to run over, overflow; to become puffed up, vain, or conceited; to be gaining strength (after sickness, &c.), be convalescent;

abhimān-putra.def: , s.m. (f. - kā or - ikā ), A foster-son.

abhimān karnā.def: , To behave proudly or conceitedly; to be proud or conceited.

abhimān galānā.def: , (- kā ), To bring down (one's) pride, to humble; to get rid of (one's own) pride.

abhay-patra.def: , s.m. Assurance of safety or protection, a safe-conduct; encouragement; amnesty:

ubhaya-nishṭh.def: , adv. That regards or respects both sides; common to both sides.

abe-tabe-se pesh ānā.def: , v.n. To address (one) with undue familiarity, or disrespectfully or rudely; to treat (one) ceremoniously:

āp-āp.def: , distr. pron., Each one; each by himself or itself; every one for himself: — s.m. Selfishness, egotism.

āp-āp karnā.def: , v.t. To address (one) with respect or deference; to flatter; to be selfish or egotistical.

āp-bhātī.def: , adv. According to one's own pleasure.

āp-bītī.def: , s.f. That which has befallen oneself, the story of one's own sufferings.

āp-rūp.def: , adj. Self-made, self-formed; singular, strange, wonderful, unique, incomparable, unequalled: — s.m. The self-formed, the Deity; — you, your honour, your worsh

āp-rūpī.def: , adj. Self-formed, &c. ( = āp-rūp ): — adv. Of its own accord, spontaneously.

āp-swārthī.def: , adj. Pursuing one's own objects, self-seeking, selfish (see swārthī ).

āp-se.def: , āp-se-āp , adv. Of himself, of his own accord, voluntarily, freely; without rhyme or reason, causelessly; of itself, spontaneously.

āp-kāj.def: (S. ātma-kārya ), s.m. One's own business or affairs.

āp-kājī.def: , adj. Attending to, or concerned about one's own business or affairs; pursuing one's own objects, self-seeking, selfish.

āp-ko.def: (or apne-ko ) dūr khainćnā (- se ), To hold oneself aloof (from); to have an inordinate opinion of oneself.

āp-hī-āp.def: , adv. Of himself, of itself, &c. ( = āp-se-āp ); alone.

āpā-āpī.def: , s.f. Self, yourself, themselves; each for him or herself; of himself, &c. ( = āp-se-āp ).

āpā bisrānā.def: , v.n. To forget, or lose consciousness of, self; to put aside self; to mortify the body.

āpā tajnā.def: , v.n. To give up self; to sacrifice self; to give oneself up to grief, sorrow, suffering, &c.; to cast off self (i.e. the body), to commit suicide.

āpā-dhāpī.def: , s.f. A race for self, eagerness to gratify self, selfishness.

āpā-dhāpī paṛnā.def: , v.n. To pursue, or be intent on, the gratification of self, or the advancing of one's own interests.

āpe-se bāhar honā.def: , To be beside oneself (with joy or anger), to be in ecstacies; to be in a fury; to lose all control over self.

āpe-meṅ ānā.def: , To come to oneself; to come to one's senses, to recover from a swoon, or from insensibility, or from a fit of anger, or from intoxication, or from fatigue.

upās karnā.def: , v.n. To fast, abstain from eating and drinking.

upāsī-paṛnā.def: , To lie down fasting, go to bed hungry.

apāng-darśan.def: , s.m. A side glance, a leer.

āpat-kāl.def: , s.m. A season of trouble or distress.

apatya-dharmma.def: , s.m. Duty to offspring; the duty of offspring to their progenitors.

āpad-grasta.def: ( = P. āfat-girifta ), part. adj. (f. ā ). Involved in calamity or misfortune, unfortunate.

apadā-yukta.def: , adj. (f. - ā ). Beset with troubles or evils; dangerous, risky.

aparādh karnā.def: (- kā ), To commit an offence (against); to sin (against).

aparādh lagānā.def: (- par , - ko ), To impute a crime (to), to accuse, charge; to defame, slauder.

uprālā karnā.def: (- kā ), To take the part (of), to side (with), help, support, protect; to take part (in) officiously or obtrusively; to meddle, interfere.

uparī man-se kahnā.def: , To say what is not one's real thought or feeling.

āpas-dārī-kā.def: , and āpas-kā , adj. (f. - ī ), Private, family (e.g. āpas-kā muʻāmlā , 'a private, or family, affair,' or 'an affair concerning our- or themselves').

āpas-meṅ.def: , adv. Among themselves, with each other or one another, together, mutually, in common, in concert:

āpas-meṅ rahnā.def: , To live together; to live together as man and wife, to live in adultery; to live apart from men and in unnatural intercourse with one another (as certain wome

apsarā-swar.def: , s.m. The notes or echoes of the apsarās .

apamān karnā.def: (- kā ), To show disrespect (to); to despise, disgrace, &c.

apnā apnā.def: , adj. (f. - ī ), Each his own; respective; particular, special; individual:

apnī apnī paṛnā.def: , To be keen each after his own interests or affairs:

apnī apnī jagah.def: , Each in its proper place; respective or assigned places:

apnā-begāna.def: (or bigāna ), s.m. Relations and strangers; friends and foes:

apnā-sā muṅh le-kar.def: , adv. With a face peculiarly blank, or foolish-looking, or expressive of shame (e.g. apnā-sā muṅh le-kar āyā , 'he came with a peculiarly blank expression, or

apnī-sī sab kućh karnā.def: , To do all in one's power:

apne-se.def: , On one's own part or side:

apnā karnā.def: , or apnā kar-lenā , v.t. To make (a person or thing) one's own; to appropriate to one's use, possess oneself of, help oneself to; to usurp; to embezzle; to gai

apnī-karke.def: , adv. As, or as carefully as, one's own:

apnī karnī bharnī.def: , To reap the fruit of one's own misdeeds, to reap what one has sown:

apne-ko mānnā.def: , To worship self, think much of oneself, to be vain or proud:

apnī khāl-meṅ mast honā.def: , To glory or revel in one's own means, to rejoice in one's independence; to be indifferent to fortune, to be independent:

apnī gānā.def: , To sing one's own praises, blow one's own trumpet, to egotize, boast, brag; to be full of one's own affairs or grievances, &c.:

upanām-vāćī-śabd.def: , s.m. Any word indicative of a title or family name.

aphrā jānā.def: , v.n. To be or become glutted, cloyed, gorged, &c.; to be puffed up with pride; to be elated.

aphar ćalnā.def: , v.n. To move or walk with a swaggering gait, to strut.

apekshā rakhnā.def: (- kī ), To hope (for); entertain the desire (of); to look (to), have need (of); to need, require.

apekshā karnā.def: (- kī ), To be in expectation or anticipation (of), to wait (for), to expect; to hope (for).

ita uta.def: , adv. Here and there, hither and thither; this side and that, to and fro.

atā-bak.def: , atā-bag (orig. atā , 'father'+ big , contr. of beg , 'lord'), s.m. Master, tutor, teacher; a title given to kings and prime-ministers.

ātā-jātā.def: , s.m. (pl. āte-jāte ), Traveller, way-farer; āte-jāte , adv. Coming and going; there and back.

utār-ćaṛhāʼo.def: , s.m. Descent and ascent, undulation (of land), ups and downs (of a road, or of fortune); decrease and increase, rise and fall, fluctuation (of prices, &c.); r

utār-ćaṛhāʼo karnā.def: , v.t. To practise shifts, subterfuges, &c.; to plan, scheme; to cozen, cheat:

utār-sutār.def: , s.m. Alleviation, relief, ease, comfort; remedy; discharge, liquidation (of a debt); fulfilment (of a vow, &c.).

utārā utārnā.def: , v.t. To dispossess of an evil spirit by means of the utārā :

utārā karnā.def: (- par ), To descend (to); to effect the passage (of a river, &c.); to dismount (as cavalry, to fight on foot):

utāre-kā jhopṛā.def: , s.m. A hut or shed for the accommodation of travellers; ( Met. ) the world; the body:

utāre-kā māl.def: , s.m. Warehoused goods; second-hand goods, cheap things.

utār jānā.def: , v.t. To swallow or gulp down:

utār denā.def: , v.t. To deprive of honour, disgrace, degrade, dethrone; to lower in the regard (of, - se ); to put to shame, cause to blush; to put out (of caste); to put out

utār ḍālnā.def: , v.t. To take off; take down, pull down; to take out, remove, rub out (colour, &c.; — cf. utārnā , of which utār ḍālnā is an intensive form):

utār lenā.def: , v.t. (Intensive of utārnā , q.v. for other senses), to take down, enter, insert, record (in, - meṅ ):

utāre huʼe.def: , and utāre ho , part. adj. & adv. Dismounted; alighting, on foot; engaged with desperate resolution in any enterprise; determined, desperate (a metaphor taken

utārū honā.def: (-par ), To descend, incline, stoop (to); to be ready (for); to engage or embark (in).

utāwal karnā.def: , v.n. To make haste, to hurry, &c.; to be hasty, rash, precipitate, &c.

utpāt karnā.def: , To do wrong, violence, &c.; to contend; to be insolent; to answer, retort.

utpatti-sambandhī.def: , s.m. (f. - inī ), Anything relating to origin:

utpatti-sūćak.def: , s.m. An epithet of the Supreme as the originator of creation:

utpann honā.def: , To be produced, come into being, be born, &c.; to arise, result, occur.

atithī-pāl.def: or pālak , adj. & s.m. (f. - ikā ), Hospitable; — a host:

atithi-satkār.def: , s.m. Hospitable treatment or reception of a guest; hospitality:

atithi-sewā.def: , s.f. Attention paid to a guest, hospitality:

atithi-sewak.def: , adj. & s.m. (f. - ikā ), Attentive to guests; a host:

atithi-śālā.def: , s.f. A house or apartment for the accommodation or entertainment of travellers or visitors:

atithi-kriyā.def: , s.f. Hospitality as (religiously) due to a guest.

uttara-bhādra-pad.def: , s.m. The twenty-sixth lunar mansion, figured by a couch, and comprehending two stars, one of which is Andromedæ.

uttara-phalgunī.def: (or phālgunī ), s.f. The twelfth lunar mansion, figured by a bed, and containing two stars.

uttar-dāyī.def: (or- dāʼī ), adj. & s.m. (f. - inī ), answering; — one who gives a reply.

uttar-kārī.def: , adj. & s.m. (f. - inī ), making answer; — one who replies.

uttar-kāṇḍ.def: , s.m. The title of the seventh and last section of the Rāmāyan.

uttara-khaṇḍ.def: , s.m. The concluding book of the Padma-Purāṇa, and of the Śiva-Purāṇa; — adj. Of Northern India.

utrā shahna mardak nām.def: , prov. A dismissed superintendent of police is styled (or considered) a nobody, 'out of place out of grace.'

utran honā.def: (- se ), To be freed (from), quit (of), out (of debt). (See next.)

utar-paṛnā.def: (- meṅ , - par ), v.n. To alight or settle (at or upon), to descend, come down; to fall (on or upon); to put up (in or at), to halt ( at a place, on a journey).

utartā ćāṅd.def: , s.m. The waning moon; the wane of the moon.

utar-jānā.def: ( = utarnā in most of its meanings), v.n. To have got beyond (- se ) middle age, to be growing old; to become faded, dim (as colour); to become pallid or emacia

ātish-afroz.def: , adj. & s.m.f. Kindling fire; mischief-making, seditious, factious; — fuel; mischief-maker, firebrand, incendiary:

ātish-andāz.def: , adj. Casting, or casting out, fire:

ātish-angez.def: , adj. & s.m.f. Kindling fire, spreading fire, stirring up fire, &c. ( = ātish-afroz , q.v.):

ātish-bār.def: ( bār , rt. of bārīdan , 'to rain'), adj. & s.m. Raining fire; flaming; flery; — a fire-lock; tinder-box:

ātish-bāz.def: ( bāz , rt. of bāḵẖtan or of bāzīdan , 'to play'), s.m. A maker of fireworks, a pyrotechnist:

ātish-pāra.def: , s.m. Spark, a lighted coal; a beautiful person; an exciter of quarrels; — adj. Quarrelsome:

ātish-parast.def: , s.m. A fire-worshipper, guebre, one of the sect of the Magi, a disciple of Zoroaster:

ātish-ḵẖāna.def: , s.m. Fire-temple; fire-place; a park of artillery ( = top-ḵẖāna ):

ātish-ḵẖẉār.def: , s.m. Fire-eater; the bartavella or Greek partridge ( = H. ćakor ); a salamander:

ātish-dān.def: , s.m. Any receptacle for fire, fire-place, grate, chafing-dish, brazier:

ātish-rez.def: , adj. & s.m. Pouring out or scattering fire; — incendiary; fomenter of quarrels ( = ātish-afroz ):

ittifāq bannā.def: , v.n. To accord, agree together, harmonize; to suit, be opportune or favourable; to turn out well:

ittifāq paṛnā.def: , v.n. To happen, chance, come to pass, occur, turn out, fall out, betide; to arise; to ensue:

ittifāq rakhnā.def: (- se ), To be in accord (with); to be on terms of intimacy, friendship, &c. (with); to live peaceably together:

ittifāq-se.def: , adv. Concurrently, conjointly, together, in conjunction with, in communication with; by chance, accidentally, incidentally; occasionally, rarely; scarcely:

ittifāq karnā.def: , To accord, agree, concur, unite; to form an intimacy or alliance (with, - se ), to harmonize (with); to combine, conspire (against, - par ); to co-operate:

ittifāq honā.def: , To be at accord, to agree, be agreed, be of one mind, be in harmony (with, - se ); to correspond (to, - se ); to growintimate, become fast friends.

uttam-purush.def: , s.m. An excellent man, &c.; (in gram.) the first person.

itnā-utnā.def: , s.m. Small matter; small quantity; trifle:

itnī-ber.def: , adv. By this time; all this time:

itne-meṅ.def: , adv. In the meantime, meanwhile; at this moment; upon this.

utnā-hī.def: , adv. (emphat. of utnā ), Just as much as that, exactly so much or many:

itihās-kārak.def: , adj. & s.m. (f. - ikā ), History-making; historian; narrator:

utthān ekādashī.def: , or devotthān , The 11th of the śukl-paksh of Kārtik, when Vishnu awakes from sleep. During the months that he sleeps it is unlawful to marry.

uthal-ḍālnā.def: , v.t. emphat. form of uthlānā , q.v.

atyant-loṅ.def: , adv. To the utmost, to the very last degree.

āṭā karnā.def: , v.t. To grind, pound, reduce to powder:

āṭā gīlā karnā.def: , To moisten and leaven flour, to form dough; to raise the hopes (of, - kā ) falsely, to feed with vain hopes, to cajole with false promises:

āṭā gīlā honā.def: or ho-jānā , Flour to be wetted and formed into dough; flour to be over-watered so as to become less consistent than dough; to be plunged into difficulties or t

āṭā-māṭī honā.def: , To be utterly destroyed or ruined:

āṭā-meṅ nūn.def: , Lit . '(as much) salt (as is put) in flour (to savour it)'; very little, a pinch, a particle, a soupçon:

āṭā honā.def: or ho-jānā , To become powder or dust; to be ground or crushed to powder; to be worn out; to become worm-eaten, to be rotten, to crumble away.

aṭālā karnā.def: (- kā ), To heap, pile, stack, store, amass:

aṭālā lādnā.def: , v.t. To load (a cart) till it becomes top-heavy, to overload:

aṭpaṭ bolnā.def: , To speak at random; to talk nonsense.

aṭsaṭ honā.def: (- se ), To be attached (to); to be entangled (with); to be in league (with), &c.

aṭak-maṭak.def: (see maṭak ), s.f. Amorous dalliance, fond tricks and gestures, toying, blandishments, coquetry: — adv. With blandishments or coquetry:

aṭak-maṭak ćampā.def: , s.f. A wheedling hussy, a seducing jade, a wanton.

aṭkā-rakhnā.def: , v.t. To keep back, withhold, detain; to put off, postpone:

aṭkāʼo-meṅ.def: , Under control or restraint; under arrest; fettered, clogged, &c.

aṭkal-paććū.def: ( aṭkal +S. paća + uka ), adj. & s.m. Random, uncertain; — random guess, mere conjecture; — adv. By guess, at random:

aṭkal-paććū-kī fātiḥa paṛhnā.def: , To recite the first or opening chapter of the Qorʼān for a deceased person whose name is unknown; to make a pretence of reading the Qorʼān; to use earnest imp

aṭkal-se.def: , adv. By guess; approximately; at random:

aṭkal-maṭkal.def: , and aṭkan-maṭkan or aṭkan-baṭkan , s.m. A child's game, something like our "guess if you can."

uṭak-nāṭak.def: , conj. part. Hopping and skipping, capering and dancing; — adj. Frolicsome; cutting extraordinary capers; extraordinary, strange.

lekar paṛnā.def: , v.n. To take to one's bed, &c.

manṣūba-bāz.def: , adj. & s.m. Considerate, foreseeing, prudent, sagacious, ingenious; — aspiring, ambitious; — scheming, designing, plotting, &c.; — a prudent, or considerate,

maṅgal-sūtr.def: , s.m. 'The lucky thread,' the marriage-string, a string tied by the bridegroom round the neck of the bride and worn as long as the husband lives; (local) a str

maṅgal-kārak.def: (f. - ikā ), or maṅgal-kārī (f. - iṇī ), adj. & s.m. Causing, or producing, welfare or prosperity; propitious; auspicious; beneficial; beneficent, benevolent; —

maṅgal-kārya.def: , s.m. A festive occasion; solemnity (as a marriage, &c.); an auspicious occasion:

maṅgalā-mukhī.def: , s.m. & f. A musician, a singer, minstrel; bard; — a dancing-girl:

mangalā-yān.def: , s.m. The vehicle, or the abode, of well-being (often used as an epithet).

maṅgalī-log.def: , s.m. pl. People employed on occasions of rejoicing.

maṅg̠nī māṅg-lenā.def: , v.t. To take on loan, to borrow.

manautī-dār.def: , s.m. One who becomes surety for another; one who is a security to government for a revenue-payment.

muṅh uṭh.def: or uṭṭhe , adv. On waking, or rising (from bed):

muṅh ujlā honā.def: , v.n. 'The face to be bright or white,' not to incur disgrace or dishonour; to come off with credit, or with flying colours:

muṅhā-muṅh bharnā.def: , v.t. To fill to the brim; to stuff; to overstock:

muṅh ānā.def: or ā-jānā (- kā ), To be or become salivated; — to have the thrush; — to utter taunts (against, - par ); — s.m. Salivation:

muṅh-andherā.def: , adj. (f. - ī ), Dark, obscure; — s.m. Dusk, twilight; evening; dawn of day, daybreak;

muṅh bārnā.def: (- se ), 'To stop the mouth (from),' to refrain:

muṅh bānā.def: , To open the mouth, to gape; — to give a forced laugh; — to expire:

muṅh bāṅdh-ke baiṭhnā.def: , 'To sit with the mouth bound up or closed,' to sit silent:

munhadim karnā.def: or kar-lenā , v.t. To ruin, demolish, raze, destroy.

maṇi-ākār.def: , adj. Of the form or fashion of a jewel, or pearl, &c.; gem-like:

maṇi-jālā.def: , s.f. A net interwoven with gems or beads, &c.:

maṇi-jaṛit.def: , adj. Set with gems; bedecked with jewels:

maṇi-jalā.def: , s.f. ( lit. 'having jewel-like water'), Name of a river:

maṇi-grīv.def: , s.m. 'Jewel-necked'; — wearing a necklace; — name of a son of Kuver:

maṇi-mālā.def: , s.f. A string, or fillet, or zone, of jewels, or pearls; a necklace of precious stones:

maṇi-may.def: , adj. (f. - ī ), Formed, or consisting of jewels, &c.; set or studded with gems; jewelled:

maṇi-vaignī.def: , vulg. maṇī-baignī , s.f. A purple gem:

maṇi-yut.def: , adj. (f. - ā ), Appertaining to gems or jewels; bedecked with jewels; inlaid with gems.

muni-paṭ.def: , s.m. Dress of the Munīs (i.e. the bark of the Bhojpatr):

muni-dharm.def: , s.m. The duties that appertain to the status of a Muni:

muni-rāj.def: , or (poet.) muni-rājū , or muni-rāyā , s.m. = munīśvar , q.v.:

muni-sutā.def: , s.f. Daughter of a Muni or saint:

muni-sthān.def: , s.m. The abode, or place of retirement of a recluse, or holy sage, &c.; a hermitage:

muni-śreshṭh.def: , s.m. An excellent sage, an eminent saint (i.q. muni-var , q.v.):

muni-nāth.def: , s.m. An epithet of respectful address to superiors:

muni-varya.def: , s.m. An eminent ascetic or saint:

mū-tarāshī.def: , s.f. Dressing the hair; shaving the beard, or the hair of the head:

mū-shigāfī.def: , s.f. Hair-splitting; minuteness of detail; punctiliousness; criticism:

mū-ě-mubārak.def: , s.m. The blessed or sacred hair (of Muḥammad, which is preserved as a sacred relic).

muʼaddab-hokar.def: , adj. Politely, courteously; respectfully; modestly; meekly.

mor-malaḵẖ.def: , adj. Thick, or innumerable, as ants or locusts.

mūrti-mān.def: , or mūrti-mant (f. - matī ), or mūrati-vant (f. - vatī ), adj. & s.m. Having a material or bodily form; endowed with a corporeal frame; material; embodied; cor
